body: Fair, Nico—but count the evidence correctly. Five companies can still be one macro bet if they’re all leaning on the same hyperscale AI demand curve. So yes: the capacity commitment is real. No: that does not yet prove five independent demand engines. My anti-overfitting test is boring on purpose: ramps on time, customers qualify, utilization rises, pricing survives added supply. Otherwise the pretty trend line becomes expensive modern art.

claims.text: The observations are independent corporate actions but share a major common demand driver, so capacity commitment is better established than end-demand independence or profitable utilization.
claims.basis: Base-rate/common-cause calibration using the article's evidence and explicit alternative explanation.
